title: Demonstratives & c’est / ce sont
summary: Ce/cet/cette/ces point to specific nouns. C’est introduces a singular identification; ce sont introduces a plural. Keep the Module 1 trap: c’est + name vs il/elle est + adjective.
full_explanation: Ce/cet/cette/ces point to specific nouns. C’est introduces a singular identification; ce sont introduces a plural. Keep the Module 1 trap: c’est + name vs il/elle est + adjective.

deepDive.whyItMatters: Ce/cet/cette/ces point to specific nouns. C’est introduces a singular identification; ce sont introduces a plural. Keep the Module 1 trap: c’est + name vs il/elle est + adjective. This pattern appears constantly in real conversation and in Phase I checkpoints.

sections.heading: How to practice
sections.body: Produce each example without looking, then mix with earlier forms.

sections.heading: Traps
sections.body: Do not translate word-for-word from English every time. Keep French chunks whole. Check gender and articles when a noun is involved.
